entities.name: Inalla
entities.description: A legendary human wizard, Archmage Ritualist, who rose to archmage by removing anyone in her way and secretly taught forbidden magic.

events.summary: Inalla concealed her dark sorcery and rose to archmage through the forcible removal of anyone who stood in her way.
events.quote: an ascent aided by the forcible removal of anyone who stood in her way

events.summary: As Archmage, Inalla devised an inner council to act as a dark wizards' circle where she could teach forbidden magic.
events.quote: As Archmage, Inalla devised an inner council
